blocks.text: Corcovado and city tour. Explore Rio’s most famous landmarks, beginning with Christ the Redeemer, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, with spectacular panoramic views over the city. The tour continues to the colourful Selarón Steps and the Dona Marta lookout, one of Rio’s finest viewpoints, and the impressive Metropolitan Cathedral, with panoramic views of the Sambadrome, home of Rio’s world-famous Carnival parades, and the legendary Maracanã Stadium (both from the outside).
